verses.text: How the Lord in his anger has covered the daughter of Zion with a dark cloud! He has thrown the glory of Israel down from heaven to earth. In the day of his anger he did not remember his footstool, his temple.

Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the homes of Jacob. In his fury he has torn down the fortresses of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them crashing to the ground. He has dishonored the kingdom and its leaders.

In fierce anger he has cut off all of Israel's strength. He has pulled back his protecting right hand as the enemy came. He has burned against Jacob like a blazing fire that consumes everything around it.

He has drawn his bow like an enemy. His right hand is raised like a foe's. He has killed everyone who was precious to look at. He has poured out his fury like fire on the tent of the daughter of Zion.

The Lord has become like an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her fortresses. He has made mourning and crying grow and grow in the daughter of Judah.

He has torn down his temple as easily as a garden shelter. He has destroyed his meeting place. The LORD has made Zion forget her festivals and Sabbaths. In his fierce anger he has rejected both king and priest.
The Lord has rejected his altar and abandoned his holy place. He has handed the walls of her palaces over to the enemy. They shouted in the LORD's temple as if it were a festival day.
The LORD decided to tear down the wall of the daughter of Zion. He measured it out and did not hold back his hand from destroying it. He made the walls and ramparts mourn. Together they crumble away.
Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has broken and destroyed their bars. Her king and leaders are exiled among the nations. The law is no more, and her prophets receive no vision from the LORD.
The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem bow their heads to the ground.
My eyes are worn out from weeping. My stomach is in knots. My heart is poured out on the ground because my people are destroyed, because children and babies are fainting in the streets of the city.
They cry to their mothers, "Where is the bread and wine?" as they faint like wounded soldiers in the city streets, as their lives slip away in their mothers' arms.

What can I say for you? What can I compare you to, daughter of Jerusalem? What can I liken you to, so that I can comfort you, young daughter of Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?
Your prophets saw visions for you that were false and worthless. They did not expose your sin to save you from captivity. Instead they gave you false and misleading messages.
All who pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and shake their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem: "Is this the city that was called 'the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth'?"
All your enemies open their mouths wide against you. They hiss and grind their teeth and say, "We have swallowed her up! This is the day we have waited for. We have lived to see it!"
The LORD has done what he planned. He has carried out the warning he gave long ago. He has torn you down without pity. He has let the enemy gloat over you and made your foes strong.
The people's hearts cry out to the Lord. Wall of the daughter of Zion, let your tears flow like a river day and night. Give yourself no rest. Do not let your eyes stop weeping.

Get up and cry out in the night, at the start of every night watch. Pour out your heart like water before the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the lives of your children, who are fainting from hunger at the corner of every street.
"LORD, look and see! Who have you ever treated like this? Should women eat their own children, the babies they have cared for? Should priests and prophets be killed in the Lord's holy place?
Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young women and young men have been killed by the sword. You killed them in the day of your anger. You slaughtered them without pity.

As if calling people to a festival, you called terrors against me from every side. On the day of the LORD's anger, no one escaped or survived. My enemy has destroyed the children I cared for and raised."
